records.issue: WNS +0.047 ns, WHS +0.032 ns, zero TNS/THS, and no unrouted nets pass. F97 cycles give 2.7658521 ms/frame, 1% below F98. Fastest verified target so far; board acceptance remains pending.

registry_raw.notes: impl of W21; HLS estimates inherited, real measurements in data.csv
